questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: She go to school every day.
She goes to school every day.
She is going to school every day.
She going to school every day.
questions.answer: She goes to school every day.

questions.question: Choose the correct pronoun to complete the sentence: "______ is my brother's friend." (Context: You are introducing someone to your brother)
options: He
She
It
They

questions.question: Which sentence uses the correct article?
options: I have a brother and two sister.
I have a brother and two sisters.
I have brother and two sisters.
I have a brothers and two sisters.
questions.answer: I have a brother and two sisters.

questions.question: Complete the sentence with the correct preposition: "She is interested ______ learning French." (Context: She wants to study the language)
options: in
on
at
of

questions.question: Which sentence describes a completed action in the past?
options: I live in London last year.
I lived in London last year.
I live in London last year.
I was living in London last year.
questions.answer: I lived in London last year.

questions.question: Choose the correct verb form: "They ______ to the cinema yesterday evening." (Context: They went together)
options: go
going
went
gone

questions.question: Which sentence is grammatically correct?
options: This is the man who I know.
This is the man whom I know.
This is the man who I knows.
This is the man which I know.
questions.answer: This is the man who I know.

questions.question: Select the correct word to complete the sentence: "______ is raining outside, so we must stay inside." (Context: It is currently raining)
options: It
He
She
They

questions.question: Which sentence uses the correct present simple tense for a habit?
options: I usually drink coffee in the morning.
I usually drinked coffee in the morning.
I usually drinking coffee in the morning.
I usually drank coffee in the morning.
questions.answer: I usually drink coffee in the morning.

questions.question: Choose the correct phrase: "I am looking ______ my keys." (Context: You are trying to find them)
options: for
at
in
on
